<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child+)>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent "Expanded Entity Text">
  <!ENTITY % pent "<!ELEMENT internal (#PCDATA)>">
  %pent;
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.com/ns2">
  <!-- This is a top-level comment containing markup-like strings <test>&ent;</test> -->
  <ns2:child>
    <?target data-processing-instruction?>
    <![CDATA[
      Here is some CDATA with unescaped <tags>, &ersands;, and quotes "'.
    ]]>
    &ent;
  </ns2:child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author)>
  <!ATTLIST book id ID #REQUIRED>
  <!ENTITY author-entity "Jane Doe">
  <!ENTITY % ext-entity SYSTEM "http://localhost/external.dtd">
  %ext-entity;
  <?pi-target pi-data?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="urn:catalog" xmlns:pub="urn:publisher">
  <!-- Author database catalog file -->
  <pub:book id="b1">
    <title>XML Parsing Techniques</title>
    <author>&author-entity;</author>
    <?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Review: Excellent resource for CDATA and DTD testing.
    ]]>
  </pub:book>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?xml-app-info name="fuzzer-test"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % p1 "<!ENTITY ent1 'Param Value 1'>">
  <!ENTITY % p2 "<!ENTITY ent2 'Param Value 2'>">
  %p1;
  %p2;
  <!ENTITY combined "&ent1; and &ent2;">
]>
<document xmlns="http://xml.org/doc" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- Multi-namespace container with comments -->
  <section xsi:schemaLocation="http://xml.org/doc schema.xsd">
    <?target-processing-instruction data="value'"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Nesting CDATA sections <inside> tag structures.
    ]]>
    &combined;
  </section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY item-ref "Widget">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-snippet "<!ENTITY snippet-ent 'Snippet Content'>">
  %dtd-snippet;
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:inv="http://inventory.org/ns/inventory">
  <!-- Inventory list containing various special constructs -->
  <inv:item id="i1">
    <?action-pi status="active"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Special characters in CDATA: <item>, &, 'single', "double".
    ]]>
    &item-ref; - &snippet-ent;
  </inv:item>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?xml-meta generator="custom-fuzzer"?>
<!DOCTYPE note [
  <!ELEMENT note (to, from, heading, body)>
  <!ELEMENT to (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT from (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT heading (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY sig "The Management">
  <!ENTITY % param-ent "<!ENTITY sub-sig 'Department of Testing'>">
  %param-ent;
]>
<note xmlns="http://www.w3.org/TR/html4/" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Internal communication memo -->
  <to>All Fuzzers</to>
  <from>&sig;, &sub-sig;</from>
  <heading>Status Update</heading>
  <body>
    <?target-action process="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      All systems operational. CDATA block active.
    ]]>
  </body>
</note>
```
